title: Thinking vs. Doing: Improving Agent Reasoning by Scaling Test-Time Interaction
authors_zh: Junhong Shen、Hao Bai、Lunjun Zhang、Yifei Zhou、Amrith Setlur、Shengbang Tong、Diego Caples、Nan Jiang、Tong Zhang、Ameet S. Talwalkar、Aviral Kumar（机构：Carnegie Mellon University、Scribe、University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign、University of Toronto、University of California, Berkeley、The AGI Company、New York University）
paper_type_zh: 测试时交互扩展与在线强化学习研究（NeurIPS 2025）
best_for_zh: 研究智能体如何在单步思考与环境交互之间分配推理预算的读者。
one_line: TTI scales a web agent’s test-time interaction horizon, then trains that behavior with a horizon curriculum so the agent can explore, backtrack, and re-plan.
TTI 将网页智能体的环境交互步数作为测试时预算，并用逐步拉长交互上限的在线学习，使其能够探索、回退和动态重规划。
why: It shows that more test-time actions can acquire information unavailable to a longer reasoning trace before acting.
inclusion_reason: It makes the agent interaction horizon an explicit inference-time budget and evaluates its scaling against longer per-step reasoning.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Most test-time scaling for language-model agents buys additional computation by asking the agent to think longer before it acts. A longer chain can reorganize information already in the context, but it cannot reveal a changed web page, inspect another listing, or recover from an action whose consequence is visible only after execution. For interactive tasks, treating more tokens at one decision point as the whole budget therefore misses the cost and value of acting again.

This paper asks how an agent should spend extra inference computation when the environment can provide new evidence. Its decision object is an interaction horizon: the permitted number of observation-action cycles in one rollout. The study compares that budget with per-action reasoning under web-task success evaluation, and asks whether a longer horizon lets a policy collect information, backtrack after mistakes, and revise a plan instead of merely extending the text produced before its next action.

多数语言模型智能体的测试时扩展，都是要求智能体在行动前进行更长的思考。更长的推理链能够重新组织已有上下文中的信息，却无法发现已经变化的网页、查看另一条商品信息，或在执行动作后才看见后果时进行恢复。对于需要交互的任务，把单个决策点的更多 token 当作全部预算，因而忽略了再次行动的成本和价值。

本文研究当环境能够提供新证据时，智能体应如何花费额外推理计算。其决策对象是交互视野，即一次轨迹中允许的观察—行动循环次数。研究在网页任务成功率评估下，将这种预算与每一步的推理计算进行比较，并考察更长视野能否让策略收集信息、在犯错后回退、修订计划，而不是只在下一次行动前延长已经生成的文字。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central idea is that a web agent can scale along an interaction axis as well as a thinking axis. Extra environment steps expose fresh observations, so they can support exploration, revisiting an earlier page, checking a tentative answer, and re-planning after a failure. This is complementary to increasing reasoning tokens per action: one enlarges the information available to the policy, while the other mainly increases computation over the same information.

The authors turn that distinction into Test-Time Interaction, or TTI. Instead of training only at one fixed maximum trajectory length, TTI begins with short rollouts and gradually permits longer ones through a multiplicative horizon curriculum. The resulting execution record contains a task, successive observations and actions, the allowed horizon, terminal feedback, and compute cost. It makes interaction length a controllable deployment budget rather than an incidental property of an agent trace.

核心观点是，网页智能体既可以沿着交互轴扩展，也可以沿着思考轴扩展。额外的环境步数会带来新的观察，因此能够支持探索、回到先前页面、核查暂定答案，以及在失败后重新规划。这与增加每次行动的推理 token 互补：前者扩大策略可获得的信息，后者主要是在相同信息上增加计算。

作者将这种区分实现为测试时交互方法，即 TTI。它不只在一个固定的最大轨迹长度上训练，而是从短轨迹开始，通过乘法式视野课程逐渐允许更长的轨迹。由此得到的执行记录包含任务、连续观察和动作、允许的视野、终止反馈和计算成本。它把交互长度变成可控制的部署预算，而不是智能体轨迹中偶然出现的属性。

title: Method
方法
html:
The paper first isolates interaction scaling at inference. A prompting-based “check-again” intervention asks an agent to reconsider after it signals completion, then the study contrasts this with forcing more reasoning at each step and with best-of-n under a total-token budget. In WebArena, the controlled setting samples 62 test tasks and reserves 750 tasks for online training; the maximum interaction horizon is 30. Each rollout records browser observations, actions, completion attempts, the number of steps, tokens, and environment success.

The training method, TTI, applies online reinforcement learning with a binary task signal over extended web trajectories. A fixed short horizon restricts exploration, whereas a fixed long horizon is difficult to optimize because early exploratory moves receive delayed and noisy credit. TTI therefore increases the maximum horizon over training and mainly uses online filtered behavior cloning. The released repository supplies WebVoyager and WebArena configurations, task files, evaluation scripts, and two model checkpoints; reproduction should also pin containers, prompts, allowed attempts, and the curriculum schedule.

论文首先在推理阶段单独考察交互扩展。基于提示的“再次检查”干预会在智能体声明完成后要求其重新考虑；随后研究在总 token 预算下，将它与强制每一步进行更多思考、以及最优多样本选择进行对比。在 WebArena 中，受控设置抽取 62 个测试任务，并保留 750 个任务用于在线训练，最大交互视野为 30。每条轨迹记录浏览器观察、动作、完成尝试、步数、token 和环境成功结果。

训练方法 TTI 在延长的网页轨迹上使用带二元任务信号的在线强化学习。固定的短视野限制探索，而固定的长视野由于早期探索动作获得延迟且噪声较大的归因，较难优化。因此，TTI 在训练中增加最大视野，并主要采用在线过滤行为克隆。发布的仓库提供 WebVoyager 和 WebArena 配置、任务文件、评估脚本与两个模型检查点；复现还应固定容器、提示、允许尝试次数和课程日程。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that a Gemma 3 12B TTI agent reaches an average 66.5% task success rate on the reported WebVoyager setting, and the project page describes this as the leading result among open agents trained on public data. On that setting, the curriculum outperforms a fixed horizon of 10 by 7.4 percentage points and a fixed horizon of 30 by 21.3 points. The authors also evaluate on full WebArena and report the strongest result among the compared open-source agents trained through self-improvement.

The evidence also distinguishes the proposed axis from prompting alone. A check-again prompt can improve most reported WebArena domains, and the project’s equal-token comparison shows interaction scaling with the steepest improvement trend relative to per-step budget forcing and best-of-n. These findings support the claim that more actions can be valuable, but they are benchmark-specific: task evaluators, browser state, model version, prompt, rollout limit, and external web behavior determine whether an apparent horizon gain transfers.

论文报告，使用 Gemma 3 12B 的 TTI 智能体在所报告的 WebVoyager 设置中达到平均 66.5% 的任务成功率，项目页将其描述为使用公开数据训练的开放智能体中的领先结果。在该设置下，课程方法比固定视野为 10 的基线高 7.4 个百分点，比固定视野为 30 的基线高 21.3 个百分点。作者还在完整 WebArena 上评估，并报告在所比较的、通过自我改进训练的开源智能体中取得最强结果。

证据还将所提出的轴与仅靠提示区分开来。再次检查提示能够改善所报告的多数 WebArena 领域；项目页中相同 token 预算的比较显示，交互扩展相对每步预算强制和最优多样本选择具有最陡的提升趋势。这些发现支持更多动作可能有价值的主张，但它们仍受基准限制：任务判定器、浏览器状态、模型版本、提示、轨迹上限和外部网页行为都会决定视野收益能否迁移。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier test-time methods for agents generally allocate a larger budget to a single action: longer chain-of-thought, repeated decoding, or candidate selection. This work changes the unit of allocation to the environment interaction itself. A new step does not merely create another candidate answer; it can alter the agent’s evidence by navigating, querying, observing a result, or returning to a prior state. That makes the horizon a substantive compute-and-information choice.

The other contribution is to train this choice rather than treating it only as a prompt trick. The horizon curriculum confronts the optimization trade-off between insufficient exploration at short trajectories and noisy, delayed credit at long ones. The work does not establish that more interaction is always superior, nor does it replace per-step verification. Its reusable signal is a controlled comparison and training recipe for deciding when a system should buy more environment contact rather than more internal deliberation.

先前面向智能体的测试时方法通常把更大预算分配给单个动作：更长的思维链、重复解码或候选选择。本工作将分配单位改为环境交互本身。新增的一步不只是产生另一份候选答案；它能够通过导航、查询、观察结果或返回先前状态改变智能体的证据。因此，交互视野是一项实质性的计算与信息选择。

另一项贡献是训练这种选择，而非只把它当作提示技巧。视野课程正面处理短轨迹探索不足，与长轨迹归因噪声大且延迟之间的优化权衡。该工作并未证明更多交互总是更优，也不能替代每一步验证。其可复用的信号是一种受控比较和训练配方，用于决定系统何时应购买更多环境接触，而非更多内部审慎思考。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The results are tightly coupled to web environments whose observations and terminal evaluators make exploration useful. Longer horizons increase latency, browser or tool cost, and opportunities to drift; the project itself documents over-reliance on resets or search as a fallback and limited final-step self-verification. A check-again prompt only revisits a decision after completion, while the learned curriculum requires online collection, environment containers, and nontrivial compute. Claims about an optimal split between interaction and per-step thought should therefore be remeasured for each tool interface, task distribution, model, evaluator, and wall-clock budget.

结果与网页环境紧密耦合，这些环境的观察和终止判定器使探索具有价值。更长视野会增加延迟、浏览器或工具成本，以及偏离目标的机会；项目本身记录了把重置或搜索过度当作后备方案，以及末步自我验证有限的问题。再次检查提示只能在声明完成后重新审视决策，而学习得到的课程需要在线收集、环境容器和不可忽略的计算资源。因此，关于交互与每步思考之间最优划分的主张，应针对每种工具接口、任务分布、模型、判定器和实际运行时间预算重新测量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when an agent can learn from environment feedback and the design question is whether to spend serving budget on another action or on deeper reasoning before the current action. An evaluation log should retain task identity, observation snapshots, actions, thought tokens if used, interaction horizon, completion attempts, reset or backtracking events, terminal reward, success, total tokens, tool calls, latency, and monetary or infrastructure cost. Compare policies at matched task sets and matched total budgets, then inspect whether extra steps produced new evidence or only repeated behavior.
当智能体能够从环境反馈中学习，而设计问题是应把服务预算花在再执行一次动作，还是在当前动作前进行更深思考时，本工作很有用。评估日志应保留任务标识、观察快照、动作、若使用则思考 token、交互视野、完成尝试、重置或回退事件、终止奖励、成功结果、总 token、工具调用、延迟以及金钱或基础设施成本。应在匹配的任务集和总预算下比较策略，再检查额外步数是否产生新证据，还是只重复了既有行为。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the paper as a budget-allocation study, not only as a web-agent training paper. First separate the prompting intervention from the learned TTI curriculum, and compare each against per-step reasoning or best-of-n under the same token accounting. Then examine the horizon schedule, reward timing, task-generation boundary, and failure cases. The decisive question is whether an added action obtained information that changes a later choice; if it did not, a longer interaction trace should not be interpreted as evidence of useful test-time scaling.
应把论文作为预算分配研究来读，而不只把它当作网页智能体训练论文。先将提示干预与学习得到的 TTI 课程分开，再在相同 token 统计下把二者分别与每步思考或最优多样本选择比较。随后检查视野日程、奖励到达时间、任务生成边界和失败案例。决定性问题是，新增动作是否获得了会改变后续选择的信息；如果没有，就不应把更长的交互轨迹解释为有用的测试时扩展证据。
